## GitHub: a simpler way to log in {.smaller}

Last week `gh-scoped-creds` tripped many of you (the "select repositories" step, and the 8-hour expiry). New one-time setup — a **personal access token**:

1. On GitHub: profile photo → **Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic) → Generate new token (classic)**. Tick `repo`, expiry **Dec 31, 2026**, copy the token.
2. In a hub terminal:
   ```bash
   git config --global --unset-all credential.helper
   git config --global credential.helper store
   ```
3. Next `git push`: username = your GitHub username, password = **paste the token** (nothing appears as you paste). It is saved; you won't be asked again.

Full instructions + common errors: **[GitHub on the LEAP hub](https://dhruvbalwada.github.io/intro-climate-modeling-fall2026/labs/github_setup.html)**

::: {.notes}
The page also keeps gh-scoped-creds as an alternative, with the missing step spelled out (adding the repo to the app's list at github.com/settings/installations). Repo link on Courseworks remains the submission.
:::

# Lab 0d · Modeling using budgets {background-color="#1a3a5c"}

## The plan {.smaller}

1. **A budget:** $A\,\dfrac{dh}{dt} = F - Q_\mathrm{out}$
2. **Two drain laws from two dominant balances:** Torricelli $Q \propto \sqrt{h}$ · Poiseuille $Q \propto h$ — we adopt the linear one, $Q = kh$
3. **Equilibrium:** $h^* = F/k$ — the level the bucket *wants*
4. **Stepping in time:** Euler, $h_{n+1} = h_n + \Delta t\,(F - k h_n)/A$
5. **Play:** vary $h_0$, $k$, $F$ — keep the plots, they come back in ten minutes

::: {.notes}
The notebook drives; the board carries the derivations (they are written out in Lab 0d for reading later). Step 5 is what the uncertainty slides point back at.
:::
